rationale: Although SCI is showing clear downside pressure—trading at 4.2% of its daily range, below both VWAP ($70.62) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($69.75) on 3.5x relative volume—the portfolio already carries 43% of its buying power in short exposure across six positions. Furthermore, with only 15 minutes remaining before mandatory market liquidation and the stock still slightly positive on the day (+0.30%) despite SPY falling 3.58%, adding further net-short exposure into the closing auction does not offer an attractive risk-adjusted return.
